fixes.explanation: Not a burden, friend. The writer says, “So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.” (Hebrews 10:35). The very next verse says, “You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.” (Hebrews 10:36). So the confidence isn't weight to drop, it's what carries you to the promise.
